decision: REJECT_BOTH; production engine remains342483aa. Inline helps translated texture but lacks robust native-pattern improvement; saturation table is slower.
scope: Numeric full-resolution 1920x1080 CPU pushFrame only, no browser/rendering/conversion/IPC. Apple M2 Max, Node24.19.0, 90 frames of which15 warmup, fresh process each trial;3 alternating trials. Native-pattern low contrast uses exact uint32 source shader formula with bottom-left to top-left Y conversion.
nativeBoundary: RGB numeric buffers reproduce the fixture shader kernel. They are not an actual browser capture, do not reproduce I420 conversion or browser scheduling, and cannot stand in for the retained native25.46ms analysis measurement.

reconstruction.contains: All three full source trees, patches, manifests, original benchmark/proof files and harness scripts; original evidence bytes are represented as parsed JSON while every source string is preserved.

inline-proof.json.scope: Exact complete finish() and live callback differential; both byte array types, unaligned fallback, alpha and black resets, aliases that fork/reconverge, source geometry changes, timestamp gaps and explicit interruption. Numeric buffers only, never rendered.

saturation-proof.json.scope: Exact complete finish() and live callback differential; both byte array types, unaligned fallback, alpha and black resets, aliases that fork/reconverge, source geometry changes, timestamp gaps and explicit interruption. Numeric buffers only, never rendered.

saturation-palette-proof.json.scope: Complete 16,777,216-color palette, exact original Float64 saturation division and explicit black exclusion. The prototype uses the table only for saturation; luminance and chromaticity remain unquantized.
saturation-palette-proof.json.memoryAccounting: Prototype global allocation reported separately. Production must include 131072 bytes in stateBytes and retain the engine memory budget.

metadataErratum: Original saturation trial harness inherited a stale scope sentence saying stateBytes unchanged. Actual measured result.stateBytes and all full original hashes are retained and show190023436->190154508. The explicit budgetComparison field and proof assert precisely+131072. Original artifacts are not rewritten.
